'''Nova Three''' was a title and [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] used by the [[Nova Three (pilot)|unidentified]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] group, [[Nova Squadron/Legends|Nova Squadron]].<ref name="if">''[[X-Wing: Iron Fist]]''</ref> 

In [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]], the Novas were part of the [[Solo Fleet]] tasked to hunt [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Zsinj]]. Nova Three participated in the [[Battle for the Razor's Kiss|battle]] for the [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|''Executor''-class Star Dreadnought]] ''[[Razor's Kiss]]''.<ref name="if" />
